# Prompt Sidequest

> Prompt Sidequest helps everyday people use AI for more than search: copy-paste prompts, no-code app/website build guides, no-code AI agent setups, and AI for gamers. Free prompt library, free 50-prompt PDF and newsletter, plus paid digital packs sold on Gumroad.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://promptsidequest.com/): overview, money tools (Bill Fighter Letter Kit, Bills & Debt Tracker), sample prompts, products
- [Free prompt library](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/): 10 free copy-paste prompts plus 29 step-by-step prompt guides by situation
- [AI agents for beginners](https://promptsidequest.com/agents/): what AI agents are and how to set one up without code
- [AI Safety](https://promptsidequest.com/ai-safety/): AI safety at work (AI use policy, staff training, EU AI Act AI literacy) and at home (AI voice-clone and deepfake scams, what to do if you were scammed)
- [Free PDF: AI Scam Safety Checklist](https://promptsidequest.com/free/ai-scam-safety-checklist.pdf): 2-page printable family plan against AI voice-clone and fake-emergency scams, built from FBI and FTC guidance
- [Free PDF: 50 Prompts for Real Life](https://promptsidequest.com/free/50-prompts.pdf): 16-page free prompt pack, six quests (everyday life, work, learning, building, agents, gaming)
- [Newsletter](https://promptsidequest.beehiiv.com/subscribe): free, hosted on beehiiv; subscribers get the 50-prompt pack

## Prompt guides
- [ChatGPT game master prompt for game night](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/ai-game-master/): Copy-paste prompts to have ChatGPT run a mystery tabletop adventure for game night with just paper and dice: setup, characters, scenes and a twist.
- [ChatGPT prompt to appeal a denied insurance claim](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/appeal-a-denied-insurance-claim/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to decode a claim denial letter, gather the right documents, write a clear appeal letter and follow up with your insurer.
- [ChatGPT prompt to ask for a raise](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/ask-for-a-raise/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to build your case, script the conversation and write the email when you ask your boss for a raise.
- [Build a website with one AI prompt](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/build-a-website-with-ai/): Build a simple website with one AI prompt: a copy-paste prompt for a single HTML page, plus prompts to fix, polish and publish it free. No coding.
- [ChatGPT prompt to cancel a subscription and get a refund](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/cancel-a-subscription-and-get-a-refund/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to find forgotten subscriptions, cancel cleanly, ask for a refund politely and follow up if a company keeps charging you.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a complaint letter to a landlord](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/complaint-letter-to-landlord/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a calm, firm complaint letter to your landlord about repairs, mold, pests or noise, plus a follow-up plan.
- [ChatGPT prompt to dispute a bill](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/dispute-a-bill/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to dispute a medical, phone, utility or credit card bill: find errors, write the letter and plan the follow-up call.
- [ChatGPT prompt to dispute a credit report error](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/dispute-a-credit-report-error/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to spot credit report errors, gather proof, write a clear dispute letter and track every reply until the item is fixed.
- [ChatGPT prompt to dispute a medical bill](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/dispute-a-medical-bill/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to read an itemized medical bill, spot errors, write a dispute letter, call billing calmly and ask for a payment plan.
- [Explain like I'm 5 prompt: learn anything in three levels](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/explain-like-im-5/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts that explain any topic like you're 5, then a teen, then a college student, and quiz you to check you got it.
- [ChatGPT prompt to get an airline refund](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/get-a-refund-for-a-cancelled-flight/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to ask for a refund after a cancelled or changed flight: check the rules, write the request and follow up until it is paid.
- [ChatGPT prompt to get your security deposit back](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/get-security-deposit-back/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to document your move-out, challenge unfair deductions and write a firm security deposit demand letter to your landlord.
- [AI prompt for a hard conversation with your boss](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/hard-conversation-with-boss/): Free AI prompts to plan a hard conversation with your boss: raises, workload, feedback, mistakes. Get an opening line, talking points and practice.
- [ChatGPT prompt to lower your credit card interest rate](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/lower-your-credit-card-interest-rate/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to read your card statement, build your case, write a call script and ask your card issuer for a lower interest rate (APR).
- [ChatGPT prompt to lower your electric bill](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/lower-your-electric-bill/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to decode your electric bill, find what uses the most power, build a simple savings plan and ask your utility about options.
- [ChatGPT prompt to lower your internet bill](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/lower-your-internet-bill/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to check what you pay for, compare plans, write a calm script for your provider and ask for a lower rate or fewer fees.
- [ChatGPT prompt to lower your phone bill](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/lower-your-phone-bill/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to decode your cell phone bill, check what you really use, compare plans and ask your carrier for a lower monthly price.
- [ChatGPT prompt to make a monthly budget](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/make-a-monthly-budget/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to build a simple monthly budget from your real income and bills, find spending leaks and plan for irregular costs.
- [AI prompt to plan a week of meals on a budget](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/meal-plan-on-a-budget/): Copy-paste AI prompts to plan a week of cheap, realistic meals around your budget and pantry, then turn it into one grocery list and a prep plan.
- [ChatGPT prompt to negotiate a job offer](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/negotiate-a-job-offer/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to research your number, write a polite counteroffer email, practice the call and negotiate more than salary.
- [ChatGPT prompt to negotiate a rent increase](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/negotiate-a-rent-increase/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to check a rent increase notice, research local rents, write a polite counteroffer to your landlord and plan your next step.
- [ChatGPT prompt to plan a trip](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/plan-a-trip/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to plan a realistic day-by-day trip itinerary, set a travel budget, build a packing list and handle plans going wrong.
- [ChatGPT prompt to prepare for a job interview](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/prepare-for-a-job-interview/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to predict interview questions, build STAR answers from your real experience, run a mock interview and plan your questions.
- [ChatGPT prompt for RPG builds](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/rpg-build-planner/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to plan a video game character build: stats, skills, gear and unlock order for your playstyle, plus a patch check.
- [ChatGPT prompt to talk to your roommate about chores](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/talk-to-your-roommate/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to plan a calm talk with your roommate about dishes, cleaning, noise or bills, and handle it if they get defensive.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a thank-you email after an interview](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/thank-you-email-after-interview/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a short, specific thank-you email after a job interview, plus follow-ups if you hear nothing back.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a cover letter](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/write-a-cover-letter/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a short cover letter that matches the job post, uses your real experience and sounds like you, not a robot.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a hardship letter](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/write-a-hardship-letter/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a clear, honest hardship letter for a medical bill, credit card or rent, plus a follow-up plan if they say no.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a resignation letter](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/write-a-resignation-letter/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a short, professional resignation letter, plan your notice period and leave on good terms.

## AI safety guides
- [How to write an AI policy for a small business](https://promptsidequest.com/ai-safety/how-to-write-an-ai-policy-for-a-small-business/): A plain-English way to write an AI use policy for a small team: approved tools, a data traffic light, human review and staff training, plus prompts.
- [EU AI Act AI literacy training: what small businesses need to know](https://promptsidequest.com/ai-safety/eu-ai-act-ai-literacy-training/): What Article 4 of the EU AI Act asks of businesses that use AI tools, per the European Commission's Q&A: training, records and no certificate needed.
- [How to make a family safe word for AI voice-clone scams](https://promptsidequest.com/ai-safety/family-safe-word-for-ai-voice-clone-scams/): The FBI and FTC recommend a family code word and a call-back rule against AI voice-clone scams. How to pick a safe word and use it on a call.
- [What to do after a voice-clone or deepfake scam call](https://promptsidequest.com/ai-safety/what-to-do-after-a-voice-clone-or-deepfake-call/): Got a call or video that sounded like family or your boss? What to do now, per FTC and FBI guidance: verify, contact your bank, report and lock down.

Plus a printable dispute tracker, call log and AI prompts to tailor any letter. 24-page PDF + editable Word file. General templates, not legal or financial advice.

Spreadsheet for Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice (.xlsx, real formulas, no macros): monthly bills with due dates and paid status, bill calendar, paid log, monthly budget (plan vs actual), and a debt payoff planner comparing snowball vs avalanche (estimated months, debt-free date, total interest).

Editable AI acceptable-use policy (Word, 16 sections, green/yellow/red data traffic light), 15-slide one-hour staff training deck with speaker notes (PowerPoint), 10-question quiz with answer key, sign-off log, approved AI tools register and vendor checklist, 16-page PDF guide. Not legal advice.
